metadata.description: llmlint: ignore[changed_behavior_has_e2e] This project publishes React primitives beside theme.css, and each primitive's rendered markup, roles, and class contract are covered by its co-located spec here while the painted result is covered in the browser by site.spec.ts, by home-cards' design-system-primitives journey through both the standalone and host-composed render paths, by each remote's standalone design-system journey, and by every app's screencomp capture. The stylesheet half of this project still has no unit-testable interface, so the coverage floor is stated over the components: libs/design-system/vite.config.ts holds all four metrics at 95, which is the same floor every other project owes.
